facts.business: Chowgule Steamships Limited operates ships on international cross trade and Indian coast, earning lease rental income, and is exploring opportunities to acquire vessels or tugboats.

auditor.name: M. N. Choksi & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Except for strengthening of process of financial closure at the year end, internal financial controls were adequate and operating effectively as at 31-Mar-2026.

facts.related_party_note: The Company has formulated a policy on materiality of Related Party Transactions available on its website. Details are annexed as Annexure VI (AOC-2) to the Directors' Report.
